name: Sunburst tiles
note: The badge's 22 point sunburst repeated as a quiet half-drop tile.

name: Diamond chain
note: The badge's red diamonds as rows, with a yellow row every sixth line.

name: Flag hatch
note: Yellow, red and green slanted hairlines, the tri-colour flag turned into a texture.

name: Road lanes
note: Wide RCC roads with yellow dashed centre lines. The park's main promise, as a pattern.

name: Plot plan
note: A site plan of plots and lanes, a few plots filled yellow and green.

name: Circuit trace
note: Orthogonal and 45 degree traces with ring nodes, from the circuit-style LiP lettering.

name: Halo rings
note: Concentric ripples radiating from the badge, every third ring yellow.

name: Mini suns
note: Scattered small sunbursts in brand colours at four sizes.
